blocks.text: K-pop agency BELIFT LAB filed a criminal complaint against an alleged stalker who allegedly targeted ENHYPEN member Jay, according to a statement posted on Weverse Tuesday, Nov. 3. The agency said the unnamed individual harassed the 24-year-old singer repeatedly and illegally posted recorded private phone calls online. They pledged to protect the artist months after severe privacy violations.
